tips: Ask for a total price before the truck is dispatched, not just the per-mile rate.
Confirm whether the hook-up fee already includes the first few miles.
Check your auto insurance policy or roadside plan first — you may already have towing coverage.
If it's safe to choose, ask to go to a shop or address of your choice instead of a private impound lot.
